### 🔧 Weapon attachments
- Guns now take attachments in four slots: sight, muzzle, grip and magazine. Press **C** with a gun in hand to fit them
- 12 parts: red dot, holo, bullseye and a 2x thermal sight; suppressor, compensator and choke; vertical grip and bipod; extended, drum and quick magazines
- Every part except the sights gives something up for what it adds. A suppressor costs damage, a drum mag slows the reload, a bipod slows your movement
- In survival, you craft the mechanical parts and get the optics, suppressor, bipod and drum mag from traders and loot. In PvP, parts unlock by tier
- The Silenced Pistol is gone, since any pistol can now take a suppressor. Saved ones come back as a regular pistol

### ⚡ Taser
- A new short-range stun gun in the melee slot. A hit locks another player in place for 10 s: they can't move or shoot
- Every shot, hit or miss, starts a 10 s recharge. A meter on the HUD shows when it's charged
- Two wired barbs fly out and stay connected to the target, and electric arcs crawl over the stunned player

### 🔭 Scopes and guns
- The Grizzly, the Ranger and the thermal sight use real magnified scopes: the zoomed view sits inside the lens, and the world around it stays visible
- Spent casings are shaped for each calibre: pistol, magnum, rifle, sniper and shotgun shells
- The ammo counter says RELOAD and shows your reload key when the magazine is empty

### 🐛 Fixes
- Jumping onto tables, chairs and pallets, or stepping onto furniture under a low ceiling, no longer gets you stuck in place
- Dumpster skips placed on maps no longer lose their walls and floor

### 🎬 Story cutscenes
- A new survival world now opens with a cinematic intro. You come to on your back in the forest while a stranger, the Drifter, guns down two of the dead closing in on you with an AK.
- He drags you back to your senses by a fire and points you at the work ahead, then walks off into the fog. The campfire he leaves behind is real, so you can use it.
- The scene is fully voiced, with subtitles, lip-synced dialogue and acted characters.
- In co-op, everyone in the world watches the intro together. Nobody can be hurt while it plays, and creatures leave you alone.
- Each story scene plays once per world and is saved with it.
